valuation.reason: Project rent ramp, Bitcoin/NCI value and parent funding require a sum-of-parts bridge.
valuation.basis: Cash flows attributable to parent common after debt, preferred and minority claims. No external consensus is authenticated in this edition.

financing.reason: Restricted project reserves, Bitcoin balances and the joint LC/revolver commitment cannot be added as general liquidity. Phase 2 financing terms and the dated build-spend schedule are incomplete.

ownership_audit.history: Current five-session comparison uses the USD Nasdaq listing. Close and adjusted close agree on its two endpoints. The full historical corporate-action series remains unaudited.
ownership_audit.corporate_actions: Nov 2023 merger exchanged 5 legacy Hut shares for 1 new common. Current Nasdaq series is USD. October 2026 repurchases already reduce November common count.
ownership_audit.dilution: Quarter-end common and October repurchases are reconciled to the latest cover disclosure; potential RSUs, other awards and minority claims are not dually counted as ordinary shares.

report.thesis: The strongest evidence is the signed lease base. The test is whether first halls deliver on schedule while restricted project assets remain sufficient to finish them.
catalysts: River Bend initial hall in Q2 2027; Beacon Phase 1 in Q3 2027.
risks: Phase 2 permanent financing still under evaluation.
Consolidated income includes digital-asset remeasurement and subsidiary economics.
invalidation: Initial service misses issuer dates or project funding requires parent recourse.
missing: Phased billable MW, project capital to complete, project distributions and parent liquidity.
